title: Fixed Part Retracted Lattice Gate
description: One newly authored complete static partly retracted lattice entrance gate. Full opposed upright frame posts carry one continuous slotted overhead box track and a grounded lower guide. Five complete slotted vertical staves with independent upper rollers, carrier stems and lower shoes guide a connected three-height four-bay network of separate front/back diagonal links and real fixed crossover/end pins. One whole leading stile has a projecting pull loop and latch tongue; a separate receiver has a real strike recess across the remaining clear doorway. This is not a solid-panel folding screen, a scissor lifting platform turned upright or a repeated freestanding barrier. All geometry newly authored, three opaque constant PBR materials, metres, Z up and centred horizontal envelope. One complete isolated static opening fixture, zero scenes and no host building. Only the displayed fixed pose is represented: no extension kinematics, sliding or rolling operation, lock/security, pinch clearances, emergency egress, access, load, installation or safety certification.
